claim: Benjamin Fulford, a former Asia-Pacific bureau chief for Forbes, says he confronted Heizo Takenaka — Japan's former minister for financial services and economic policy under Prime Minister Junichiro Koizumi — over the opening of Japan's financial system to foreign investors, and that Takenaka's camp told him Japan had been coerced under threat of an "earthquake machine." Fulford attributes the capability to HAARP, the High-frequency Active Auroral Research Program, and points to the 16 July 2007 magnitude-6.6 Chuetsu offshore earthquake, which struck the Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear plant, igniting a transformer fire and leaking radioactive water and gas. His stated mechanism: a "billion watt microwave" fired into the ionosphere, rebounding to shake a target's bedrock at its resonant frequency. HAARP is a real ionospheric-research facility near Gakona, Alaska — a 180-antenna array radiating up to 3.6 megawatts of high-frequency radio, run by the U.S. Air Force until operation transferred to the University of Alaska Fairbanks in 2015, which describes its purpose as studying how radio waves interact with the ionosphere to improve communication and surveillance. The 2007 quake is recorded by seismologists as a tectonic rupture on an offshore fault.

sources.label: Benjamin Fulford, recorded interview — his account of the Takenaka confrontation and the HAARP earthquake-weapon mechanism.
sources.quote: I started doing research and found out about HAARP... they really did know how to make earthquakes. And they do it by shooting a billion watt microwave into the ionosphere, which is a part of the atmosphere that has a lot of energy.

sources.label: HAARP — official facility, Geophysical Institute, University of Alaska Fairbanks (Gakona, Alaska): 180-antenna Ionospheric Research Instrument, 3.6 MW; USAF operation transferred to UAF in 2015.
2007 Chuetsu offshore earthquake — July 16, 2007, magnitude 6.6; struck the Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Nuclear Power Plant.
sources.quote: The earthquake caused a leak of radioactive gases from Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Nuclear Power Plant. The earthquake also caused a fire in an electrical transformer at the plant that was extinguished after two hours.

notes: Embedded clip is Benjamin Fulford (ex-Forbes Asia bureau chief, conspiracy author); he has told this Takenaka/HAARP story since ~2007-2008. 'Hazel Takanaka' in the whisper transcript is Heizo Takenaka. Real anchors: Fulford and Takenaka are real; HAARP is a real Gakona facility; the July 16 2007 M6.6 Chuetsu offshore quake did hit Kashiwazaki-Kariwa (transformer fire, minor radioactive leak). Contested/attributed: HAARP earthquake-generation, the 'earthquake machine' coercion of Japan's finance ministry, the security-police warning anecdote, the 'billion watt microwave' mechanism. Reel says 'two earthquakes both 6.8'; the cataloged main event is a single M6.6. HAARP transmitter power is 3.6 MW (effective radiated power with antenna gain reaches the ~GW range, which is likely the source of the 'billion watt' figure). Record states the claim (attributed) and what HAARP and the quake are on the documented record; it does not adjudicate the weapon claim. Pairs thematically with 2023-icecube-directed-energy-claim-001 (the South Pole 'earthquake weapon' claim) via the directed-energy-weapons theme. HAARP official-site quote left null (verbatim not pulled); 3.6 MW / 180-antenna figures are from the facility's published specs.
